raw:
I fixed B1. With "bez Meeta" in the description, Meet now stays off when the user later picks a contact for an unresolved name, and Save sends the event without a Meet call. I also fixed N3 and N7. The story's six acceptance tests and all three gates pass on the new head.

What changed for B1:
- crates/core/src/editor.rs has a new flag, `Editor::meet_described`. `described::fill` (crates/core/src/described.rs) sets it whenever the description said yes or no to Meet.
- `Editor::pick` keeps Meet as it was when that flag is set. When the description said nothing, the first guest picked still turns Meet on (MOD-06-F17).
- New unit test `a_name_picked_later_leaves_meet_as_the_description_said` in crates/core/src/described_tests.rs covers the refused, asked-for and not-mentioned cases.
- New app test `a_refused_meet_stays_off_when_a_name_is_picked_and_a_waiting_name_invites_nobody` in crates/app/src/description_guests_tests.rs drives the whole app. With the fix stashed it fails at "Meet was refused", so it catches the bug. The same test covers N3: "Zenek" is still unresolved at Save, and the attendees sent are only kasia.lis@example.com.

N7: `Sync::look_up` in crates/app/src/sync.rs now drops what an earlier look-up found if nobody took it.

The run that counts is /home/sulo/workspace/private/calendar-buddy/test-runs/2026-10-28_031431. It was made on head 76ee40b with a clean tree (snapshot true, changed_during_run false); every step of every test case ran and passed. I deleted one earlier run of my own, 2026-10-28_031406. It ran the whole workspace, so the TCs of other modules showed as blocked.
